label: Good
corporate_parent: Lixil Group — public (Tokyo Stock Exchange). Acquired American Standard in 2013. Also owns Grohe (Germany), INAX (Japan). Global building products conglomerate.
manufacturing_location: Multiple Lixil/American Standard factories. US and Mexico production. Specific factory for this model not confirmed.
outlook_rationale: Lixil is a diversified global building products company. No quality degradation reported post-2013 acquisition. Parts ecosystem remains strong. Champion 4 line unchanged in core design.
platform_disclosure: Lixil Group owns American Standard, Grohe (Germany), and INAX (Japan). It is unclear whether American Standard models incorporate INAX flush technology. Champion 4's 4-inch piston flush valve is an American Standard proprietary design, distinct from Grohe or INAX mechanisms. Lixil's multi-brand portfolio creates potential platform sharing, but Champion 4 appears to be a legacy American Standard design maintained post-acquisition.

construction.description: Two-piece, standard exposed trapway. Basic construction. Tank-to-bowl gasket and bolt connection. Not skirted, not concealed. Functional, not premium.

glazing.description: EverClean antimicrobial surface — silver-ion based. Inhibits bacteria, mold, and mildew growth on bowl surface. Effective but different technology than CeFiONtect nano-barrier (EverClean fights microbes, CeFiONtect prevents adhesion).

trapway.description: Fully glazed 2-3/8" trapway — among the largest in residential toilets. Combined with 4" piston valve, creates very fast bulk water delivery. Anti-clog design.

china_body.description: Standard vitreous china. Adequate construction but not high-fire premium. Standard chip resistance.

map_score.notes: Champion 4: consistently 1000g in MaP testing. The 4-inch flush valve + 2-3/8" trapway delivers the fastest water dump in residential toilets. Raw flush power is Tier 1 — it's the construction quality that places this in Tier 3.

performance_evidence.flush_technology: 4-inch piston flush valve — largest residential flush valve. Delivers 70% more water flow than standard 2" flapper. Simple, powerful, effective. Not as sophisticated as TORNADO FLUSH (no centrifugal rinse) but brute-force effective.
performance_evidence.bowl_cleanliness: Good — powerful flush moves waste but standard rim-fed wash pattern. EverClean glaze helps. Below TORNADO FLUSH for bowl surface rinse.
performance_evidence.noise: Can be louder than standard flush due to rapid 4" valve water release.

flush_valve.description: 4-inch piston flush valve. Simple mechanical design — piston lifts vertically for fast water delivery. Replacement parts available. Some reports of flush handle connection being a weak point on certain production runs.

fill_valve.description: Fluidmaster 400A compatible. Universal $10-20 replacement at any hardware store.

parts_ecosystem.description: Excellent parts availability. Universal Fluidmaster fill valve. Champion 4 piston valve replacement available at Home Depot/Lowes. Standard wax ring, supply line. Best DIY repairability in the lineup.

durability_evidence.diy_repairability: Fully DIY. All standard tools. Two-piece design allows easy tank removal. Fill valve, flush valve, handle, wax ring — all standard replacement procedures. The simplest toilet to repair.
durability_evidence.warranty: Limited lifetime on china body, 5-year mechanical components. Best warranty in the mid-tier — 5yr mechanical exceeds TOTO (1yr) and Kohler (1yr) on components.

sources.snippet: American Standard Champion 4: MaP 1000g consistently. 4-inch flush valve + 2-3/8" trapway = fastest water delivery in residential. MaP PREMIUM certified.
Champion 4 is a 'workhorse.' Simple 4" piston design = fewer failure modes than complex mechanisms. Parts universal. Plumber value recommendation.
American Standard Champion maintains strong flushing performance. No quality degradation noted post-Lixil acquisition.
Champion 4: 'good enough for a quality bathroom.' Universal parts, easy repairs. 5-year mechanical warranty is best mid-tier.
EverClean antimicrobial surface effective for hygiene but does not prevent waste adhesion like CeFiONtect. Standard vitreous china — not high-fire premium.
American Standard ranked in top 3 by plumbers. Champion 4 specifically praised for reliability and value. Post-Lixil quality maintained.

bottom_line: The American Standard Champion 4 is the performance/value champion. MaP 1000g with the largest flush valve in residential toilets (4 inches). Raw flush power matches TOTO and Kohler at a fraction of the price. The dock is construction quality — standard vitreous china (not high-fire), two-piece standard (not skirted), no nano-glaze. Greatest repair ecosystem in the category: universal Fluidmaster fill valve, available piston valve, 5-year mechanical warranty. Lixil parent is stable. This is what plumbers mean by 'good enough for a quality bathroom.'
